## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 5, 2026 - Nov 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _katiejduane_, Nov 11, 2026, 1/5: "I’m disappointed to report that since deciding to PAY for this app, it does nothing but freeze and crash. I’ll start a run on my phone, but then look down to discover it’s keeping track of time but not distance. I try to pause and restart only to discover the screen is frozen. Quitting and restarting the app does not help. Just finished my most recent run 20 mins ago and still can’t get the app to load. Super bummed out as I was excited to use their training programs to prepare for some races in my near future but it doesn’t seem possible! Hoping this is an issue that others are experiencing so they fix this problem. Willing to re-write my review if things change or improve!"
            2. _SATeach_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "I have continued to have issues with the app since September 28 after starting a new plan. I reached out to support. Four days later I heard from someone about an update which I had already completed. I heard back the following day asking if it worked. No it did not was my response. Another three days pass and asked if I was still having issues. I said yes the same issues persisted. So here I am four days later (week 2 from reporting issues) and have yet to hear back at all. So disappointed!"
            3. _Pboswells_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used Runkeeper for 13 years. Latest update has broken indoor runs as it no longer records heartbeat, no longer syncs to Apple Watch, no longer records workout to Apple Health. Logged issue weeks ago but no fix. Essentially useless for indoor runs now."
<!--/ir-theme-->
